title: Meeting recording
description: Whether meeting audio and video are recorded.
appliesText: A saved change applies to streaming meetings that start after the save, and to the next Virtual Participant to start.

recordAudio.title: Record meeting audio
recordAudio.description: Record and store meeting audio from streaming clients and Virtual Participants, unless the client says otherwise.

recordScreenVideo.title: Record screen video from streaming clients
recordScreenVideo.description: Let streaming clients offer to record shared-screen video. Needs EnableVideoRecording and meeting consent.

recordVpMeetingVideo.title: Record Virtual Participant meeting video
recordVpMeetingVideo.description: Let Virtual Participants record the meeting's video as well as audio. Needs EnableVideoRecording.
